id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_130.pack|cs_: "Oh, {var:1}. So you came looking for me.
"Actually... I'd decided I'd fight Mordegon once I met {var:1} again.
"But I couldn't work up the nerve to meet Papi to leave the parade with him. Until I saw that father and son in Phnom Nonh.
"'Talking things out leads to understanding.' I steeled myself and came, but I'm still scared of seeing Papi...
"Did I ever tell you I'm from this town?
"...Hendrik told you. As you heard, I was drilled from childhood to become a knight.
"So I thought I'd live here as a knight forever. Then the circus came.
"That circus show was so fun! Strength welled up inside me! I was enchanted by the circus's power!
"And I knew it. Smiles make people strong! That's my chivalry!
"I couldn't hold back. I told Papi that what I needed now was training as a traveling entertainer, and he objected, naturally...
"So I told him: I'll master a chivalry only I can, one that makes everyone in the world smile!
"I won't come back until then! ...We fought so hard it nearly wrecked the mansion, and I stormed out of town.
"But talking to you gave me courage.
